subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.-----TRS.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 234 (T(IMP)M-32). AF-POST (affinity postulation) is the subject; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), INFO-DY (information dynamics) and SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From TR: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From INFO-DY: ATTN (attraction) and ALT-DEF (alternative definitions). From SPT-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From ATTN: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From ALT-DEF: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ALT-C-PG: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: CN-INFO (controlled information).
